purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0133 in the gauge arena: moving binding in the committed slot architecture: waiting slots do not bind, since most of their string crossings go unpaid, while a crossing that bounces when it cannot be paid, with the sign of a calm slot carried by what it holds, binds a meson and a baryon when cold and melts when warm, keeping color local, but the bound pair is stuck where E-FRC-0131 moved.
